newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates steady, liquidity stays tight.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates steady, liquidity stays tight.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates finished at 23.125 percent on Wednesday, unchanged from Tuesday, dealers said.
"A considerable amount of the money remains tied up in (the central bank's) reverse repo facility, keeping overnight rates high," said Balazs Varga of Inter-Europa Bank.
He expected O/N rates to hover around 23.00 to 23.25 percent in coming days, as tight liquidity offsets the usual downward trend towards the end of the banks' two-week reserve period.
